name: Window Snapping
description:
Windows 11 window snapping for GNOME.

• Drag a window to the left or right edge for half the screen, to any corner for a quarter, or to the top to maximize, with a frosted live preview
• Drag it to the top centre for snap layouts: halves, thirds, quarters and more (Super+Z opens them from the keyboard)
• Snap Assist fills the space that's left with your other windows
• Super+Arrow keys work exactly like Win+Arrow: halves, quarters, maximize, restore, minimize, next monitor
• Snapped windows resize together, and get their original size back when dragged away

Replaces GNOME's built-in edge tiling while it's on, and gives it back when it's off.
